desc: Ideation: identify functional-graph structure, cycle contraction (all cycle values equal), tree DP with prefix sums, O(N·M) complexity, numeric-safety and pitfall analysis.
Write the complete Python program (parsing, cycle detection + component grouping, children lists, iterative bottom-up order, numpy/pure-Python DP, component combination, output).

Validate by reasoning (no execution): samples `3 3 / 2 1 1 → 6`, `4 9 / 1 1 1 1 → 2025`; edge cases M=1 → 1, N=1 with A_1=1 → M, all self-loops → M^N, whole graph one cycle → M, multiple components, deep chain (iterative, no recursion), worst case N=M=2025 runtime O(N·M) via numpy; array-sharing/aliasing of `base` verified safe (no in-place mutation), reversed DFS order verified a valid bottom-up topological order.
